description: Adjust low stock trigger to include reserved inventory buffer: (quantity_on_hand - quantity_reserved) <= reorder_level.

air.contextSnippet: notify inventory_balances.low_stock when="quantity_on_hand<=reorder_level&quantity_on_hand>0" tone=warning label="Low Stock Alert"
air.patch: notify inventory_balances.low_stock when="(quantity_on_hand - quantity_reserved)<=reorder_level&quantity_on_hand>0" tone=warning label="Low Stock Alert"
